headline: Groß will start
body: Sports Mole (Oliver Thomas), 29 Oct 2026: Hürzeler expected to restore his strongest XI at Man City. 'Pascal Gross is all but certain to retain his starting spot in a deeper midfield position' alongside Andrés (hip cleared). Predicted: Verbruggen; … Gross, Andrés; … Kostoulas. Mitoma, Struijk, Ferguson among those still out.
